arguments.command:
python -c "
import toolz

# Test compose_left
print('Testing compose_left...')
inc = lambda i: i + 1
double = lambda i: i * 2
compose_left_result = toolz.compose_left(inc, double)(3)
print(f'compose_left(inc, double)(3) = {compose_left_result}')
assert compose_left_result == 8, f'Expected 8, got {compose_left_result}'

# Test peekn
print('Testing peekn...')
peekn_result = list(toolz.peekn(3, range(10)))
print(f'peekn(3, range(10)) = {peekn_result}')
assert peekn_result == [0, 1, 2], f'Expected [0, 1, 2], got {peekn_result}'

# Test dissoc with regular dict
print('Testing dissoc...')
dissoc_result = toolz.dissoc({'x': 1, 'y': 2}, 'y')
print(f'dissoc({{\"x\": 1, \"y\": 2}}, \"y\") = {dissoc_result}')
assert dissoc_result == {'x': 1}, f'Expected {{\"x\": 1}}, got {dissoc_result}'

# Test merge with OrderedDict
from collections import OrderedDict
od = OrderedDict([('a', 1), ('b', 2)])
merge_result = toolz.merge(od, {'c': 3})
print(f'merge(OrderedDict([(\"a\", 1)]), {{\"c\": 3}}) = {merge_result}')
assert isinstance(merge_result, OrderedDict), f'Expected OrderedDict, got {type(merge_result)}'

# Test apply
print('Testing apply...')
apply_result = toolz.apply(lambda x: x + 1, (1,))
print(f'apply(lambda x: x + 1, (1,)) = {apply_result}')
assert apply_result == 2, f'Expected 2, got {apply_result}'

# Test Compose class
print('Testing Compose...')
c = toolz.Compose([lambda x: x + 1, lambda x: x * 2])
compose_class_result = c(3)
print(f'Compose([inc, double])(3) = {compose_class_result}')
assert compose_class_result == 8, f'Expected 8, got {compose_class_result}'

# Test fold
print('Testing fold...')
fold_result = toolz.fold(lambda x, y: x + y, [], 0)
print(f'fold(add, [], 0) = {fold_result}')
assert fold_result == 0, f'Expected 0, got {fold_result}'

print('All tests passed!')
"
